name: plane-taskgraph
description: Structured task graphs in Plane: functional areas as Modules, ordering as blocked_by relations, risk as a Label, and a verification record before anything is marked done.

interface.shortDescription: Design talk in, structured Plane task graph out
interface.longDescription: Skills for writing Plane work items to a fixed template (why, scope, risk, done-criteria, verification), attaching them to functional-area Modules, recording a design as a blocked_by dependency graph, and reading it back to compute what can start now — then doing an item with risk-based pauses, Refs trailers on commits, and a verification-record comment whose changed-files list is generated from git.
defaultPrompt: 把刚才讨论的设计记到 Plane 里。
